page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-384-lssd is a high-capacity instance from the c4d server family, built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. It features 384 dedicated vCPUs and 1488.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per core. The instance is equipped with 32 local NVMe SSDs, providing high-speed local storage directly attached to the physical host, though it does not include any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its massive core count and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, this instance is designed for highly parallelized workloads that require substantial compute power alongside fast local storage. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the server represents a premium, high-density hardware class optimized for consolidating large-scale enterprise workloads rather than budget-oriented tasks. The combination of 384 dedicated vCPUs and 32 local NVMe SSDs makes this configuration suitable for large-scale databases, data warehousing, heavy ETL pipelines, and high-throughput web serving environments.
